\opt{C}{$\dfrac{E_2}{B_0}$ will be greater than $\dfrac{E_1}{A_0}$ if $Y$ belongs to group 18}
\opt{D}{If $Y$ exists in nature as $Y_2$ \& $X$ exists in nature $X_2$ then the compound $X_2Y_2$ will always be planar}
